precisions.fp8: online quantization of merged bf16 weights
precisions.W4A16: GPTQ; language Linear layers, excluding output head and multimodal towers; E4B also retains per_layer_model_projection in bf16

Gemma 4 E4B.reason: Full-model calibration forwards support shared K/V state.
Gemma 4 E4B.activation_source: Full-precision activations; quantization error is not propagated layer to layer.

quantization.comparison_scope: Cross-model quantization losses reflect both the model and its supported calibration pipeline.

benchmark.throughput_window: For concurrency > 1, completions before the final request starts; at concurrency 1, all completed requests over wall-clock time.
benchmark.ratio_reference: Same-prompt bf16 Llama proxy measured in the same benchmark block. Displayed bf16 Llama rows come from the 12B blocks; displayed fp8/W4A16 proxy rows use their separate block.

quantized_proxy_control.block: Separate benchmark block using the same serving settings and common GPTQ parameters; Llama uses sequential calibration.
quantized_proxy_control.checkpoint_selection: Retained test-selected local adapters; not the production weights

bf16_consistency.reference: Corresponding same-prompt proxies in the four primary Gemma 4 blocks
bf16_consistency.scope: Observed agreement across benchmark blocks, not a statistical equivalence guarantee

benchmark.restart_scope: For each model/precision and each of three repetitions, restart and warm the server before running the full concurrency sweep. Do not restart between concurrency levels.
benchmark.request_matching: Nested, matched test-set prefixes of 16, 24, 48, 96 and 192 requests. Prefix caching stays enabled across levels within a repetition, so later levels can reuse earlier input prefixes.
benchmark.measurement_scope: Repeated warmed-server inference benchmarks using fixed trained checkpoints, not training repetitions or independent cold-input workloads. Ranges are observed minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals.

resource_estimation.window: Full wall time for all 192 requests, including ramp-down.
resource_estimation.aggregation: Compute each quantity per repetition, then report its median across the three repetitions.

power_sampling.scope: GPU power only on DGX Spark; excludes CPU and other system components and is not wall-plug energy.

resource_estimation.scope: Short-workload extrapolations, not measured production capacity or cost. Device-hours are elapsed device time, not GPU compute-hours, and are not the reciprocal of the separately windowed headline throughput.

reporting_scope.supplementary: Qwen Nothink candidates and additional block-specific bf16 proxy measurements
reporting_scope.bolding: Column bests within each displayed table independently, including Llama proxy rows in Table 3 and ties at displayed precision. Lower weight memory and latency; higher F1, speed-up and throughput.
reporting_scope.throughput: Main-table throughput, throughput ratios and prose rankings refer to concurrency 64; they do not establish the same ordering at other concurrency levels.
reporting_scope.main_table: Manuscript Table 3: validation-selected Gemma 4 E4B/12B JO/FT at three precisions, plus six separately trained Llama proxy variants.
reporting_scope.prior_adapter_table: Appendix B, Table 6: twelve retained test-selected Gemma 3 and Qwen Think adapter/precision rows; Qwen is served with thinking disabled.
reporting_scope.decision_guide: Table 4: six JSON-Only configurations spanning Gemma 4 and separately trained Llama proxies. Labels such as fastest and lowest memory are scoped to this guide, not all measured models.

memory_scope.loaded_weights: Loaded weight memory only, excluding KV cache and other server memory.
memory_scope.server_budget: The fixed 85% GPU-memory-utilization budget is not a measurement of loaded weights or total deployment memory.
memory_scope.kv_cache_capacity: Reported token capacity is a serving configuration capacity, not a measurement of total deployment memory or production capacity.

batching_crossover_scope: Weight reuse, dequantization and matrix computation are hypotheses for the observed ranking change. Concurrency 64 does not establish a constant decode batch of 64; no kernel profiling establishes the cause.
